content:
hey friend,

i hope you're doing well. i wanted to remind you that election day is coming up and your vote really matters. it's a simple way to make your voice heard and help shape the future of our community. please take a little time to go to your polling place, or if you prefer, vote early or by mail. every ballot counts, and together we can make a difference.

let me know if you need any help finding your polling location or understanding the ballot. i'm happy to go with you if you'd like company.

take care and see you soon,

[your name]
